Key.English: Percentage of an object's cost refunded when Zeus deletes it. Note that deleting corpses and wrecks also refunds.
Placing units, vehicles and static weapons costs curator points, shown as the resource bar in the Zeus interface. When disabled, everything is free. Costs refresh when the Zeus interface is reopened.
Points gained per minute. 100 points is a full resource bar.
Points each Zeus begins the mission with. 100 points is a full resource bar.
